text: The bakery should launch the new sourdough line, as it presents a unique opportunity to differentiate themselves. The heritage grain blend will not only offer a new taste experience but also cater to the growing demand for specialty grains. Moreover, the bulk flour contract discount could help reduce production costs, making the product more competitive in the market. The comparable rye line's success after launch demonstrates that consumers are eager for new and diverse offerings. By offering this sourdough line, the bakery can increase its market share and attract more customers.
